sri_lanka.title: Arrest warrant issued for Rajangane Saddharathana over failure to appear in court

cards.what_happened: The Colombo Fort Magistrate's Court issued an arrest warrant for Rajangane Saddharathana on the 25 after he failed to appear in court. The case involves alleged social media statements said to be detrimental to religious harmony. Magistrate Pasan Amarasena also ordered notices to be issued to his bail sureties.
details: According to Newswire, the Colombo Fort Magistrate's Court issued the warrant on the 25 because Rajangane Saddharathana did not appear before the court. The case concerns alleged statements on social media that were said to harm religious harmony. Magistrate Pasan Amarasena made the order.

The court acted after receiving submissions from the Criminal Investigation Department. It also ordered that notices be issued to Saddharathana's bail sureties. The case has been adjourned to February 24, 2027, for the Government Analyst's reports to be submitted.

Saddharathana was expelled from the Buddhist monastic order. He had earlier been arrested by the CID over the alleged controversial statements and was released on bail. He is now in remand custody over a separate case linked to the tense situation at the sacred city of Anuradhapura.
key_facts: Colombo Fort Magistrate's Court issued an arrest warrant for Rajangane Saddharathana on the 25.
He failed to appear in a case about alleged social media statements harmful to religious harmony.
Magistrate Pasan Amarasena ordered notices to his bail sureties after CID submissions.
The case will be heard again on February 24, 2027, for Government Analyst's reports.
Saddharathana was expelled from the Buddhist monastic order.
He was previously arrested by the CID and released on bail.
He is in remand custody over a separate case involving the sacred city of Anuradhapura.
cards.whats_next: The case will be taken up again on February 24, 2027, for the submission of the Government Analyst's reports.
cards.blurb: Court issues arrest warrant for Rajangane Saddharathana after he misses hearing over social media posts.
cards.spoken: Good morning. A court in Colombo has issued an arrest warrant for Rajangane Saddharathana. The Colombo Fort Magistrate's Court made the order on the 25 because he did not show up for a case involving alleged social media statements said to harm religious harmony. Magistrate Pasan Amarasena also ordered notices to be issued to his bail sureties, acting on submissions from the Criminal Investigation Department. The case is set to return on February 24, 2027, so the Government Analyst's reports can be submitted. Saddharathana was expelled from the Buddhist monastic order and had been arrested before by the CID over the same alleged statements, though he was released on bail. Right now he is in remand custody over a separate case tied to the tense situation at the sacred city of Anuradhapura.
